summary_insights: The company maintains a robust liquidity position with a current ratio of 2.54, well above the standard 1.5 benchmark.
The quick ratio of 1.47 indicates that the business can meet its short-term obligations using only liquid assets, without relying on inventory sales.
Net current assets (working capital) are strong at £4.51m, providing significant operational headroom.
The capital structure is conservative, with a low gearing ratio of 11.4%, suggesting minimal reliance on long-term debt relative to equity.
Inventory represents the largest component of current assets at £2.6m (35% of total current assets), which warrants monitoring for turnover efficiency.
The balance sheet is underpinned by a healthy cash reserve of £2.29m, representing 27% of the total asset base.
Shareholder equity is substantial at over £5m, though a breakdown of retained earnings versus share capital was not explicitly detailed in the summary table.
